2609.09410.title: Benchmarking Hybrid Deep Research Across Database Querying and Web Search
2609.09410.paper_summary: While autonomous agents have made significant strides in "deep research" by iteratively navigating the open web to synthesize information, real-world problem-solving is rarely confined to a single environment. Complex analytical tasks inherently require agents to weave together evidence from both ambiguous unstructured text (e.g., the open web) and highly precise structured data (e.g., relational databases). However, existing benchmarks evaluate these modalities in isolation, failing to capture the critical "handoff" - the ability to preserve constraints when moving evidence between systems. We introduce HybridDeepResearch, to our knowledge the first deep-research benchmark that requires both web search and SQL to form a complete, verifiable answer. The benchmark contains 380 tool-dependent tasks grounded in LiveSQLBench-Base-Lite databases and public web corpora, validated through automated checks and human review, and covering three reasoning patterns: SQL2S, S2SQL, and Parallel. Evaluations across proprietary and open-weight models under various agentic scaffolds reveal that even state-of-the-art models like GLM-5.2, Claude-Sonnet-4.6 and GPT-5 achieve only about 50-54% Pass@8 on the hard subset. Notably, results show that directional reasoning is substantially more difficult than parallel intersection, highlighting that bridging structured and unstructured information spaces without losing constraints remains a major open challenge for agentic systems. Code and datasets are publicly available at GitHub (https://github.com/Snowflake-AI-Research/HybridDeepResearch) and Hugging Face (https://huggingface.co/datasets/Snowflake/HybridDeepResearch).
2609.09410.paper_summary_zh: 雖然自主代理在「深度研究」方面已經取得了顯著進展，透過反覆瀏覽開放網路來合成資訊，但現實世界的問題解決很少局限於單一環境。複雜的分析任務本質上需要代理將來自模糊的非結構化文本（例如，開放網路）和高度精確的結構化數據（例如，關聯數據庫）的證據編織在一起。然而，現有的基準測試將這些模式孤立評估，未能捕捉到關鍵的「交接」——在系統之間移動證據時保持約束的能力。我們推出了HybridDeepResearch，據我們所知，這是第一個需要同時使用網路搜索和SQL來形成完整、可驗證答案的深度研究基準。該基準包含380個依賴工具的任務，基於LiveSQLBench-Base-Lite數據庫和公共網路語料庫，通過自動檢查和人工審核進行驗證，並涵蓋三種推理模式：SQL2S、S2SQL和Parallel。在各種代理框架下對專有和開放權重模型的評估顯示，即使是像GLM-5.2、Claude-Sonnet-4.6和GPT-5這樣的最先進模型，在困難子集上也僅達到約50-54%的Pass@8。值得注意的是，結果顯示方向性推理明顯比平行交集更具挑戰性，突顯了在不失去約束的情況下橋接結構化和非結構化信息空間仍然是代理系統面臨的一個重大挑戰。代碼和數據集可在GitHub（https://github.com/Snowflake-AI-Research/HybridDeepResearch）和Hugging Face（https://huggingface.co/datasets/Snowflake/HybridDeepResearch）上公開獲取。
